data.long_meaning: The name Baqian is derived from the Arabic word 'baq' which means 'garden'. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies a place of growth and prosperity, a paradise on earth, and a symbol of Allah's blessings. The name Baqian carries the meaning “A garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baqian usually hope their child will grow to embody a garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A place of divine blessings and growth.
